summary.text: Joseph Hoolihan is a candidate with no party affiliation for the Florida House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Ocean Fitts and Republican Jordan Varnadore.
A licensed real estate agent, he says he has lived in the area since 1988 and is running on housing affordability, property insurance reform and responsible growth.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Hoolihan earned a bachelor's degree from St. Petersburg College, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working in real estate.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a local since 1988, comes from a family of seven, and has spent the last decade as a licensed real estate agent.
Hoolihan said in the survey that he is not a politician, that having no party means he owes no favors to a party or donor group, and that he sees growth in Manatee County as needing accountability.
He listed housing affordability, property insurance reform, responsible growth, eliminating false information and artificial intelligence policy as areas of public policy he is passionate about.
